decision: Memory is a continuity layer only. Render/Postgres/source-repo evidence overrides Memory.
reason: Prevent stale AI context from becoming production truth.

decision: Treat the 40 shadow discovery providers and 5 real/testing providers as separate populations at all times.
reason: Discovery research must not be confused with current real execution providers or gain broker authority.

decision: Provider Lab research/profile/replay work must remain isolated/fail-safe relative to live broker routing.
reason: Research failure must not block or mutate real-money execution.

decision: Use AIDY as bounded independent market/context truth for eligible Provider Lab research, not as broker/execution authority.
reason: Preserve clean separation between market intelligence and provider execution systems.

decision: Keep provider_research_profiles as the mutable current-state cache and record meaningful provider identity/style/behaviour changes in an append-only point-in-time provider_research_profile_versions ledger.
reason: Later provider intelligence must reconstruct what was actually known at a timestamp without future-profile leakage or fabricated historical state.

decision: Provider Intelligence research must fail closed unless an immutable provider-profile version was effective by the signal timestamp. Pre-Day-7 trades are explicitly legacy_unresolvable and cannot be fair-score eligible; current provider state must never be projected backwards.
reason: Close hindsight leakage before joining provider signals to independent AIDY market context.

decision: Day 11 is complete as a provider-by-provider fail-closed characterization milestone, not as a universal reconciliation GREEN. Paper trust is granted only when the unchanged provider_day11_v1 provider and global sample floors plus delta/lifecycle thresholds all clear; M1-unreconcilable providers are documented and excluded rather than guessed.
reason: Production run 00ddf1dc-5bcf-48b4-bab1-7f03d0c6cb88 produced 82 attempted / 23 comparable under the unchanged 5-provider / 30-global sample contract. No provider may receive paper A/B trust by bypassing the global floor or using broker truth to resolve paper.

decision: Provider Intelligence Day 12 fingerprints are built only from the 40 shadow discovery providers using closed, score-eligible, PIT-resolved forward paper evidence. Hierarchical posterior partial-pooling estimates are primary; raw per-cell rates are descriptive only. Minimum evaluable N is 30 and statistical authority remains WAITING-FOR-FORWARD-EVIDENCE below future authorised validation gates.
reason: Prevent tiny-N/raw-rate winner's-curse decisions, hindsight contamination and population mixing while allowing the Day 12 engineering harness to be production verified before enough forward evidence exists.
source: Notion Provider Intelligence Master Build Day 12; PR #147; production SHA d48a81744af6dda5e644b929d713d3d1ec95c6d3; production run 92c29d7a-fd65-41ad-bacc-fa082666d870

decision: Provider Intelligence governance must use the existing provider_research_profiles research states learning -> shadow -> qualified rather than a parallel rollout state machine. qualified grants paper-research eligibility only; it cannot mutate sources.status or grant broker/live-money authority. Day 14 governance thresholds remain PROPOSED_UNAPPROVED until an explicit owner decision approves them, and a separate human live gate remains mandatory outside this subsystem.
reason: Keep one authoritative provider research-state model, prevent scanner resets or hidden parallel state drift, and ensure research qualification can never silently become execution authority.

decision: Freeze the automatic Super Signals trading/provider-monitoring/research runtime from the standard XAUUSD Friday close at 23:57 Europe/Sofia until Monday 01:01 Europe/Sofia, while leaving the web app/stored views available and not claiming user-initiated provisioning is blocked.
reason: There is no standard XAUUSD trading during the weekly closure; continuing broker/provider/research polling wastes resources and creates misleading settlement/error churn.

decision: Persist B-F provider intelligence as append-only research evidence: PIT market context, provider fingerprints, research governance, provider-specific adaptation and observe-only combined-book conflicts. This subsystem may not mutate live source status, use historical numeric levels as current execution evidence, perform broker netting or gain live-money execution authority.
reason: Build richer provider intelligence without allowing research inference to silently become execution control.

decision: AIDY's strategic destination is to become an independent Gold/XAUUSD trader-intelligence system: understand Gold market moments, form its own thesis, identify its own setups, judge or disagree with providers, and eventually propose/manage its own trades. Telegram providers are training/evidence inputs, not the end product.
reason: Keep future AIDY work aligned to autonomous Gold understanding rather than reducing AIDY to provider parsing/ranking.

decision: The independent-trader north star does not change current live authority or the owner's 1% risk directive. AIDY-generated theses/setups must graduate through forward paper/shadow evidence and an explicit owner/live gate before any additional broker authority is considered.
reason: Separate product ambition from current production safety and prevent roadmap language from silently changing real-money behaviour.
source: explicit owner direction plus existing production safety contract

decision: The next major build is an owner/admin AIDY Data Hub backed by durable database/current views. Merely opening or refreshing the Hub must not itself invoke OpenAI, MetaAPI or external AIDY research calls.
reason: Make AIDY/provider intelligence visible every day without creating a new API-cost or polling loop.
source: explicit owner direction 2026-09-13 and B-F current-view preparation

decision: Record the live risk contract as one percent planned risk per ENABLED TP/RUNNER LEG, not one percent per signal. Entry sections distribute target legs and never multiply the risk budget, so four TP/runner legs mean four percent planned signal risk.
reason: Memory previously recorded 'owner risk directive 1% only', which understates planned signal risk by the leg count and could mislead a future agent reasoning about real-money exposure.

decision: The authoritative production code is feature/day-10-shared-telegram-sources as pinned by render.yaml. Neither main nor the branch named production may be treated as live. Any agent must verify the deployed branch head before reasoning about production behaviour.
reason: main is 141 commits behind the deployed branch and a branch literally named production is not deployed, so the default assumption that main is live is wrong and dangerous here.
source: render.yaml; git branch comparison at 2026-09-14 between 8019f66, 4bb664b and ade297e

decision: Record the automatic protection ladder exactly as implemented: TP2 hit cancels every unused entry order for the setup and moves every open TP3+ leg to its own entry (per-leg breakeven); TP3 hit moves every remaining TP4+/runner stop to the signal TP2 price. Existing protection is never loosened.
reason: Memory previously paraphrased this as 'TP1 + TP2 hit -> move SL to entry', which names the wrong trigger and hides that breakeven is per-leg rather than per-signal.
